resources.string: Home Depot Helper
Home Depot Helper

Types a Home Depot sign-in code into the code field of the Home Depot app when a verification code email arrives and you tap its notification. It only looks at the Home Depot app, only while a code is waiting to be typed, and it stores nothing.

When you tap a Home Depot order notification from Notification Keeper, this helper takes you to the exact place in the Home Depot app: the order itself for a shipped, delivered, rescheduled, cancelled or confirmed order, your purchase history when the email names no order number, and for a sign-in verification code it copies the code and types it into the app\'s code field. Anything else simply opens the Home Depot app. It works in the background on its own, so you can close this window.
✓ The helper is on, so a verification code is typed into the Home Depot app for you.
✗ The helper is off: a verification code is only copied, and you paste it yourself. Turn on "Home Depot Helper" in Settings, then Accessibility.
Fix
✓ The helper can switch itself back on after an update.
The helper cannot switch itself back on after an update. Grant it once over adb: pm grant local.hdhelper android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
✓ The Home Depot app is installed.
✗ The Home Depot app is not installed, so notifications open homedepot.com instead.
